messages:
maria: Heads-up: SummitHealth RFI needs a capability matrix, POC ops plan, deployment options note, and a 3-month pricing ballpark (100M tokens/mo + 10k embeddings). 48h turnaround. Who can own which piece?

tom: Ill do the capability matrix. Procurement wants explicit rows for quantization, batching, fallback.

lela: Ill draft the POC ops plan and the Hosted/Dedicated/Private table. Will call out BYOK/KMS and audit logs.

maria: Add a short perf blurb for 2k context + 512 gen and an estimated hosted vs dedicated cost. Finance approval needed for discount.

tom: Uploaded draft matrix to drive: https://drive.internal/sales/summithealth/matrix-draft.xlsx

infra-bot: (uploaded) summit_rfi_assets_v1.zip  includes: matrix-draft.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_snippet.md

lela: Ops snippet (example):
```
route: summit-prod
model: redwood-7b-quant
canary: 5% / 24h
rollback: latency>2s || errors>1%
```

maria: Two quick clarifications from Summit: 1) Do we hand over model weights? 2) Can the POC run in their AWS account?

tom: We dont ship Redwood-managed model weights. Open models can be provided per license; performance variants stay on our runtime.

lela: POC in customer AWS: Hosted=no, Dedicated=possible via VPC peering + reserved nodes, Private=yes (VPC or on-prem). I'll add a clear table.

maria: Target to send final bundle by tomorrow 09:00 PST. Ill assemble once finance confirms pricing. :thumbsup:
